description: Fixed version for the current importer. The previous version used 8 rooms with capacity=2, but run_allocation_case created only one bed per room row. This version represents 16 bed-slots explicitly as 16 room rows with capacity=1, so it tests the allocation behavior using the DB structure currently supported.
expected_result: Beds loaded should be 16 because the current importer creates one bed per rooms.csv row.
No room/bed-slot should have more than one student assigned.
No accessibility-related no_feasible warning should appear.
checklist: Check Unassigned students says No unassigned students.
Check no capacity or gender violation.
